items.html: No provider internals — the git branch / worktree / clone mechanics are implementation (v1 worktreeManager); L0e models only the contract → impl
No teardown lifecycle — teardown(ref) on terminal/cancel is a future extension (v1 cleanupWorktreeWorkspace), not in the L0e contract → later
No provider health / availability validation beyond name resolution → later
No provisioning-failure handling — a provider that accepts the name but fails to provision (or fails later) surfaces as a kernel FAIL event (L0d); retry / compensation is later → later / §18
No run-override cascade of the spec — template-only at L0e → later
No durable delivery (L8), actor process launch (tmux), or credential / grant (L7) → L8 / L7
No conditional / per-step runtime context — the requirement is whole-run (none | required); a step or child acquiring context later is category 3 → later
No full ContextAssembly — L0e adds only the runtime/workspace projection; general context_blocks rendering → L2b
